title: High-throughput SARS-CoV-2 RNA extraction from nasopharyngeal swabs
author: Koen Vandelannoote
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bk6qkzdw
materials: Power on the Ender VX-500 machines.
Power off the Ender VX-500 machines.

steps.title: Scan barcodes and log samples
steps.instruction: Scan the barcodes of the 91 nasopharyngeal swabs with a barcode scanner, open the “20200908_Ender_VX-500_extraction_template.xlsx” spreadsheet, and fill the “SampleID” column of the “Sample log” sheet. Randomly assign one negative extraction control per set of 24 swabs and one PCR no‑template‑control (NTC) in the sheet. The spreadsheet will automatically generate five plate‑dispensing charts (four 24‑sample extraction layouts and one 96‑well eluate‑combination layout). The spreadsheet file is attached under the abstract tab.

steps.title: Transfer swab medium to deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: In a Class II biosafety cabinet, pipette 100 µL of each swab transport medium into the corresponding wells of a deep‑well 96‑well plate using the plate‑layout charts as a guide.

steps.title: Attach PCR strips to tube holder
steps.instruction: Place three 8‑tube PCR strips onto the “Tube holder” so that the caps fit tightly into the holder openings; hold the strips by the caps only and avoid touching the outside of the tubes.

steps.title: Secure tube holder
steps.instruction: Insert the provided Allen hex wrench to lock the “Tube holder” in place, ensuring consistent positioning.

steps.title: Insert magnetic bars
steps.instruction: Place three “Magnetic bars” into the openings of the locked “Tube holder”.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, dispense 18.5 µL of lysis buffer into columns 1, 5 and 9 of a 96‑well plate with V‑shaped wells; resuspend any salted‑out guanidine thiocyanate crystals before dispensing. Then incubate the plate at 65 °C for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Add nuclease‑free water
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, add 80 µL of nuclease‑free water (NFW) to columns 4, 8 and 12.

steps.title: Add 80 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, add 150 µL of freshly prepared 80 % (v/v) ethanol to columns 2, 3, 6, 7, 10 and 11; note that ethanol concentration can drop in the BSC airflow, so prepare fresh solution.

steps.title: Add swab sample to lysis wells
steps.instruction: Transfer and pipet‑mix 37 µL of the nasopharyngeal swab transport medium from the deep‑well plate into columns 1, 5 and 9 of the reagent plate using a multichannel pipette and the appropriate plate‑dispensing chart.

steps.title: Room‑temperature incubation 1
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 1 minute (00:01:00).

steps.title: Add SPRI bead mix
steps.instruction: Transfer and pipet‑mix 30 µL of SPRI bead mix into columns 1, 5 and 9 with a multichannel pipette; shake the bead mix before use because the beads settle quickly.

steps.title: Add 100 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Transfer and pipet‑mix 85.5 µL of 100 % (v/v) ethanol into columns 1, 5 and 9 using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Room‑temperature incubation 2
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 5 minutes (00:05:00). The prepared plates must be loaded onto the Ender VX‑500 machines immediately after this incubation.

steps.title: Load plates onto Ender VX‑500
steps.instruction: Insert the four 96‑well plates onto four prepared Ender VX‑500 extraction machines, confirming correct orientation by checking the A1 marker.

steps.title: Start extraction program
steps.instruction: On each Ender VX‑500, turn the knob, select “Print from TF”, choose the file “RNA_ex_v10.gcode” (attached under the abstract tab), and start the run.

steps.title: Extraction run sequence
steps.instruction: The machine will execute the following timed steps: collect bead‑RNA complex from lysate (5 min), Wash 1 – vortex (1 min) then collect bead‑RNA complex (1 min 30 sec), Wash 2 – vortex (1 min) then collect bead‑RNA complex (1 min 30 sec), air‑dry (5 min), elute – vortex (1 min) then collect beads (1 min), raise magnetic bars out of eluates. After a total of 20 minutes the instrument beeps to indicate successful completion.

steps.title: Remove plates from instrument
steps.instruction: Carefully take the 96‑well plates out of the Ender VX‑500 machines.

steps.title: Combine eluates on magnetic rack
steps.instruction: Place the plates on a 96‑well magnetic rack and, using a multichannel pipette, transfer 50 µL of eluate from each plate to a fresh 96‑well plate that will combine the eluates of the four extraction runs; discard (sacrifice) 30 µL of each eluate to prevent SPRI bead carry‑over.

steps.title: Detach tube holder
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the “Tube holder” from the Ender VX‑500 adaptor.

steps.title: Decontaminate PCR strips
steps.instruction: Using paper tissues, release the three 8‑tube PCR strips from the tube holder and immerse the holder in a bath containing 1 % sodium hypochlorite solution for at least 10 minutes (00:10:00) for decontamination.
